units.title: 四级选词：冰盐浴中的热量流动
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: Where the Heat Went
materials.text:
A classroom demonstration placed a sealed container inside an ice-and-salt bath. The surrounding salt water was ____1____, a liquid solution of salt in water. Under the demonstrated conditions, salt lowered the bath’s ____2____ point, the temperature at which the relevant liquid began turning to ice.

The ____3____ of some ice absorbed energy. The tutor asked where that energy came from rather than say the salt had created cold from nothing. Heat could ____4____ from the warmer container and its contents towards the colder surroundings.

Through the container wall, energy moved by ____5____, transfer associated with direct contact within the material. The outer bath was ____6____ to reduce unwanted heat arriving from the room. This protection did not stop every transfer indefinitely.

The contents were ____7____ under the demonstration’s procedure so the state near one surface did not simply represent an unmoving layer. As cooling continued, ____8____ could form, small solid structures appearing in the contents.

The class recorded ____9____, how hot or cold the measured part was, at named times. A result was described as ____10____ only where the contents were similar throughout rather than frozen at one edge and unchanged elsewhere. The activity explained a particular process; it did not make a recipe or a claim about every material placed in every salt bath.

questions.prompt: Where the Heat Went: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: salt water solution直接定义brine盐水。mixture泛混合物不命名所述盐水种类，volume体积、conduction过程、crystals固粒不合。

questions.prompt: Where the Heat Went: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: point liquid begins ice定义freezing point冰点。melting point为固转液方向相反，thermal泛热性质不命名这相变点，其他词不合。

questions.prompt: Where the Heat Went: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: ice changes absorbs energy语境为melting融化。freezing冰成固放出热的过程非此叙述，mixture混合物、volume体积不是冰的融化。

questions.prompt: Where the Heat Went: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: heat from warmer towards colder需transfer传递。stirred为过去分词、thermal形容词等不作could后的原形动词；其他候选无这项动作。

questions.prompt: Where the Heat Went: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: through wall direct contact material定义conduction传导。transfer泛转移不具体命名墙内接触机制，volume体积、mixture混合物不是机制。

questions.prompt: Where the Heat Went: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: reduce room heat arriving定义insulated隔热。saturated饱和、solid固态、thermal热的均不表示加阻热保护，其他词不合。

questions.prompt: Where the Heat Went: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: avoid unmoving layer，contents被搅动stirred。insulated外层隔热不使内容混合，saturated饱和、uniform均一为性质非此过程动作。

questions.prompt: Where the Heat Went: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: small solid structures form定义crystals晶体。mixture泛混合、brine液盐水、volume体积不是复数固态结构；其他候选词性不合。

questions.prompt: Where the Heat Went: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: how hot cold定义temperature温度。volume体积、thermal形容热、conduction传导不同于测冷热程度量。

questions.prompt: Where the Heat Went: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: similar throughout rather edges different定义uniform均匀。solid仅固态不保证各处一致，saturated饱和也非空间均匀，其他项不合。

units.title: 四级选词：闪光下转轮的表观运动
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: The Wheel That Seemed to Stop
materials.text:
A classroom film showed a marked wheel in ____1____, turning around its centre. Its repeated movement was ____2____, returning through a regular cycle rather than changing without a pattern. The film then showed the wheel under short ____3____ of light instead of steady illumination.

The ____4____ between successive bursts affected what viewers saw. Each brief view ____5____ the wheel’s position at one moment rather than showing all movement between moments. Under one arrangement, the mark appeared ____6____, staying in the same visible place even though the wheel continued moving.

With another timing, the apparent ____7____ could reverse: the mark seemed to progress the other way. The physical wheel had not necessarily reversed. The tutor identified this mismatch as ____8____, a misleading appearance created when a changing process was observed through discrete samples in that way.

The bursts and the repeating position could be ____9____ so that their timing corresponded. A view under ____10____ light, present without the same breaks, gave different information about the motion.

The lesson did not ask students to inspect operating machinery or recreate the lighting setup. Its evidence was the described classroom film and its stated conditions. The point was to distinguish actual movement from the pattern made visible by an observation method.

questions.prompt: The Wheel That Seemed to Stop: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: turn around centre定义rotation旋转。vibration振动不特指绕中心周转，frequency频率是运动属性、exposure曝光非这类动作本身。

questions.prompt: The Wheel That Seemed to Stop: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: regular repeating cycle定义periodic周期性的。continuous持续不保证规律周期，stationary静止相反，transparent透明与运动形式无关。

questions.prompt: The Wheel That Seemed to Stop: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: short bursts light定义flashes闪光。exposure是受光过程单数非复数光脉冲，blur模糊、frequency频率不是这些一阵阵光。

questions.prompt: The Wheel That Seemed to Stop: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: between successive bursts定义interval间隔。frequency单位时间次数，exposure单次受光时段不等相邻间的距离，direction方向不表时差。

questions.prompt: The Wheel That Seemed to Stop: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: position one moment not whole motion为sampled取样。synchronised只是时序对应不表记录瞬间样本，stationary静止性质非采集动作。

questions.prompt: The Wheel That Seemed to Stop: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: same visible place despite movement定义stationary表观静止。continuous不断不等不移动，transparent透明、periodic周期不等停在同处。

questions.prompt: The Wheel That Seemed to Stop: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: mark progress other way指direction方向。rotation可泛旋转但此处reverse后明确other way所指方向，且第1空锁其运动名称；其他词不合。

questions.prompt: The Wheel That Seemed to Stop: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: described mismatch discrete samples named aliasing混叠。blur模糊是失清晰而非采样产生错误运动模式，exposure受光、vibration振动不命名该现象。

questions.prompt: The Wheel That Seemed to Stop: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: timing corresponded定义synchronised同步。sampled取样不必时刻对应，periodic周期也可能不同步；其他项不合。

questions.prompt: The Wheel That Seemed to Stop: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: light present without breaks定义continuous连续。transparent透明、stationary不动、periodic重复都不等常亮不中断；其他词词性不合。

units.title: 四级选词：针织样片中的线圈与张力
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: One Loose Loop in the Row
materials.text:
A textile class examined a prepared sample of knitting. The yarn curved around to make a ____1____, an open ring rather than a straight segment. The connected loops together made a ____2____, a sheet-like textile rather than a single ring.

The tutor used a ____3____, a slender tool carrying loops during the demonstration. The sample showed horizontal ____4____ of units across it and vertical ____5____ extending through successive lines. These terms described two different directions in the fabric.

The ____6____ of the yarn concerned the pulling force maintained during work. Where the yarn had been left too ____7____, it hung with excess looseness rather than being held at the intended pull. Elsewhere, a loop was ____8____, turned so its crossing differed from the surrounding examples.

A dropped connection could allow part of the fabric to ____9____, the linked structure coming undone. The class compared an untreated example with one that had been ____10____, its relevant connection restored under the tutor’s demonstration.

They did not identify every difference as damage: pattern choices could also create changes. The record named the intended structure before judging the sample. Understanding a row, a column and a connection helped learners describe a fault precisely, rather than call every uneven part simply bad knitting.

questions.prompt: One Loose Loop in the Row: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: open yarn ring直接定义loop线圈。fabric是整体织物而非单一圆环，needle工具、purl一种针法、tension拉力均非这段开放环本身。

questions.prompt: One Loose Loop in the Row: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: fabric指连接线圈形成的整片织物，后文sheet-like textile直接定义。loop是单个环而非整片，rows/columns是片内排列方向，needle为工具，purl为针法，其他词不命名这里的整体纺织物。

questions.prompt: One Loose Loop in the Row: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: slender tool carries loops定义needle织针。purl是针法、loop是线环、fabric为织物都非工具。

questions.prompt: One Loose Loop in the Row: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: horizontal lines across样片定义rows横行。columns为纵列，loop单环、purl针法不是横向多针排列。

questions.prompt: One Loose Loop in the Row: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: vertical through successive lines定义columns纵列。rows横行已对照，其他候选不指纵向单位排列。

questions.prompt: One Loose Loop in the Row: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: pulling force yarn定义tension张力。elastic为可伸缩形容词、uniform均匀、purl针法、stitch针目不是施拉力。

questions.prompt: One Loose Loop in the Row: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: excess looseness rather intended pull定义slack松的。elastic弹性是伸缩性质不等松弛，uniform均匀不能解释过松，knitted已织不评松紧。

questions.prompt: One Loose Loop in the Row: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: turned crossing different定义twisted扭转。knitted织成只过程不说明交叉异常，repaired修好与此局部不同形态不等同，其他词不合。

questions.prompt: One Loose Loop in the Row: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: linked structure coming undone定义unravel脱散。cast原形可投放但不指线圈结构逐步松脱，purl为针法动词非自行散开；其他候选不合。

questions.prompt: One Loose Loop in the Row: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: connection restored定义repaired修复。twisted扭转是差异之一，knitted已织不保证故障修复，elastic属性非恢复连接，其他项不合。

units.title: 四级选词：糖溶液中的结晶与回收量
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: The First Tiny Crystal
materials.text:
In a classroom account of crystal growth, water acted as the ____1____, the liquid in which sugar could dissolve. Sugar that had ____2____ no longer remained as separate visible grains. Together, the dissolved material and liquid formed a ____3____ rather than the original dry pile.

Under stated conditions, the liquid became ____4____, containing as much dissolved sugar as the described conditions allowed. This did not mean every change in temperature or composition would leave that limit unchanged.

As some water ____5____ into the air, the remaining system could develop solid material again. The resulting structure was described as ____6____, arranged as a crystal rather than an arbitrary heap of loose powder.

The beginning of a small new crystal was associated with ____7____, the formation of an initial structure from which growth could proceed. Tiny existing crystals used to start growth were called ____8____ in the account. They were not plant material despite sharing a familiar name.

Unwanted material introduced into the system consisted of ____9____. Its presence could change the result, so the class did not assume every differently shaped crystal proved a different sugar. The recovered amount was the ____10____ under the stated procedure, not automatically all the sugar initially present.

The account connected dissolving, changing conditions and forming a solid. It did not imply that every clear liquid had the same composition or that one visible crystal revealed the entire history of the material.

questions.prompt: The First Tiny Crystal: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: liquid in which sugar dissolves定义solvent溶剂。solution是糖水整体，precipitate固态析出物、particles颗粒不单指承担溶解的水。

questions.prompt: The First Tiny Crystal: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: no separate grains sugar入液定义dissolved溶解。evaporated进空气、stirred搅拌不保证溶开，crystalline形容结晶态与此不同。

questions.prompt: The First Tiny Crystal: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: dissolved material together liquid定义solution溶液。solvent只液媒不是整体，precipitate为析出物，particles粒非均一溶液状态。

questions.prompt: The First Tiny Crystal: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: as much dissolved allowed conditions定义saturated饱和。transparent透明不能证已至上限，crystalline晶态是固体排列，其他项不合。

questions.prompt: The First Tiny Crystal: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: water into air定义evaporated蒸发。dissolved溶入不等进气，stirred搅动不是相变，其他候选无该过去分词。

questions.prompt: The First Tiny Crystal: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: structure arranged crystal定义crystalline结晶的。saturated是溶液容量状态，transparent透光不说明晶格组织，其他词不合。

questions.prompt: The First Tiny Crystal: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: initial structure growth begins定义nucleation成核。precipitate是析出固体而非开始形成核的过程，solution体系、yield量均不等。

questions.prompt: The First Tiny Crystal: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: existing tiny crystals start growth称seeds晶种。particles泛粒不一定既有晶体用作起始，impurities为不想要异物，其他候选不合这个角色。

questions.prompt: The First Tiny Crystal: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: unwanted introduced material定义impurities杂质。seeds是有意提供生长核，particles只是形态不说明杂入，precipitate是析出产物不一定外来。

questions.prompt: The First Tiny Crystal: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: recovered amount procedure定义yield回收产量。solution为体系、solvent液媒、precipitate产物种类都不直接指收得量。

units.title: 四级选词：会议提案与行动记录
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: Who Was Going to Do It?
materials.text:
A student society’s meeting began with an ____1____, the planned list of business to discuss. One member brought a ____2____ suggesting a new event. The idea had not yet been approved simply because it appeared on the list.

The accompanying text was a ____3____, a version open to revision rather than a final public announcement. Another member raised an ____4____, a stated concern about the suggested cost. The chair asked the group to ____5____ what the estimate included before responding to it.

Under the society’s stated rules, the group reached a ____6____ about the proposal. Discussion alone had not established the outcome; the record named what had actually been agreed. The chair then asked whom to ____7____ the next task to, give responsibility rather than leave it as something everyone vaguely expected somebody to do.

Each action had an ____8____, the person responsible for following it through, and a ____9____, the time by which it should be completed. The record could therefore be reviewed at the next meeting.

The ____10____ preserved the meeting’s decisions and relevant actions. They were not intended as a word-for-word copy of every remark. The society kept a draft for checking before confirming the record, so a convenient summary could be corrected rather than acquire authority merely because it had been typed neatly.

questions.prompt: Who Was Going to Do It?: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: planned business list定义agenda议程。minutes为会议后记录、proposal单建议、decision结果、quorum法定出席数都非讨论清单。

questions.prompt: Who Was Going to Do It?: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: suggesting new event not approved定义proposal提案。decision已定结果，objection反对意见、deadline期限不是这项待审建议。

questions.prompt: Who Was Going to Do It?: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: open revision not final定义draft草稿。consensus共识、quorum出席数、minutes会议记录不等于当前活动文稿可改版本。

questions.prompt: Who Was Going to Do It?: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: stated concern cost定义objection异议。proposal原建议、decision决定、consensus共识均非担忧反对。

questions.prompt: Who Was Going to Do It?: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: what estimate included需clarify澄清。assign是分任务不是说明费用构成，其他候选不作to后该原形动词。

questions.prompt: Who Was Going to Do It?: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: named agreed outcome under rules定义decision决定。consensus全体共识不是本文必定程序，unanimous形容词也不合a后名词，proposal提案未定不是结果。

questions.prompt: Who Was Going to Do It?: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: give responsibility task to person定义assign分派。clarify澄清对象内容不等给责任，其他词不作此任务分配原形。

questions.prompt: Who Was Going to Do It?: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: person responsible action定义owner责任人。quorum人数阈值、agenda清单、minutes文档、deadline时限均非承担行动者。

questions.prompt: Who Was Going to Do It?: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: time by completed定义deadline截止期。decision结果、agenda列表、quorum人数、minutes记录均非该完成时限。

questions.prompt: Who Was Going to Do It?: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: meeting decisions actions record定义minutes纪要。draft草稿是版本状态非文类，agenda事前清单、proposal单建议均不指会后决议行动记录。

units.title: 四级选词：名字列表的大小写与排序
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: Why Ten Came Before Two
materials.text:
A club moved its member list into a simple computer tool. The program treated typed names as ____1____, sequences of symbols, and compared the ____2____ within them. Its first output surprised the secretary because the order differed from the handwritten list.

For ordinary names, the club wanted an ____3____ arrangement, following its stated alphabet rules. It also had to decide how to handle ____4____, the distinction between upper- and lower-case letters. These choices were not explained merely by a button labelled sort.

Some labels included ____5____ representing numbers. Comparing them as text could place ten before two under a character-by-character rule. A ____6____ comparison instead interpreted the relevant parts as numbers.

The secretary also found names sharing the same ____7____, the beginning part of the text. A shared beginning did not establish that the entire name or person was identical. The list checked exact ____8____ separately from different entries that only looked similar.

For equal comparison keys, a ____9____ method preserved their earlier relative order under the rule used. The club documented whether it would ____10____ selected marks during comparison, leave them without influence, while retaining the original spelling for display.

The lesson was not that one order was correct for every language and purpose. The tool needed an explicit rule for the task, and the displayed names needed to remain distinguishable from the simplified forms used to compare them.

questions.prompt: Why Ten Came Before Two: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: sequences symbols in computer定义strings字符串。entry条目是列表角色非数据符号序列类型，sequence单数不匹配复数typed names，collation排序规则不是输入对象。

questions.prompt: Why Ten Came Before Two: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: symbols within strings定义characters字符。digits只数字子类不包名字字母，duplicates重复条目、prefix开头部分不是每符号。

questions.prompt: Why Ten Came Before Two: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: following alphabet定义alphabetical字母顺序。numerical按数、lexical虽泛词汇相关但本题专明字母表且其余规则另定，stable相等键顺序不等字母序。

questions.prompt: Why Ten Came Before Two: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: upper lower letters定义case大小写。suffix后缀不表示大小写区别，prefix前缀、collation整体排序规则不具体命名字母大小写属性。

questions.prompt: Why Ten Came Before Two: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: symbols representing numbers定义digits数字字符。characters泛符号第2空已用且此处特指数值表示，prefix开头不必数字，other nouns不合。

questions.prompt: Why Ten Came Before Two: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: interprets as numbers定义numerical数值比较。alphabetical按字母、lexical按文本词汇，stable只保相等键原序，不表示数字值读取。

questions.prompt: Why Ten Came Before Two: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: beginning part text直接定义prefix前缀。suffix为结尾片段，与beginning相反，entry整体、sequence序列不特指前段。

questions.prompt: Why Ten Came Before Two: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: exact repeated entries定义duplicates重复项。characters是符号、strings是所有输入并不说重复，digits数字非完全同条；其他候选不合。

questions.prompt: Why Ten Came Before Two: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: equal keys preserves earlier order定义stable稳定排序。lexical词法、alphabetical字母、numerical数值各可稳定也可不稳定，均不定义该保序性质。

questions.prompt: Why Ten Came Before Two: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: leave selected marks no influence定义ignore忽略。其他候选无可接would后的该原形动词，保原拼写展示不同于比较时忽略符号。

units.title: 六级选词：保险风险池中的相关性与支付能力
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: Many Policies, One Storm
materials.text:
A fictional finance seminar grouped many insurance contracts into a ____1____. Policyholders paid a ____2____, the stated price for the cover, while later requests for payment under the contracts were ____3____. The exercise separated money received from obligations that might arise.

The insurer’s ____4____ described the extent of the risk it had taken on. Counting policies alone did not establish that extent if the amounts and conditions differed. A thousand contracts need not represent one uniform quantity.

Losses that occurred without the specified dependence on one another were modelled as ____5____. By contrast, events driven by the same storm could be ____6____, tending to occur together. Adding more properties in the same affected area did not necessarily spread that common source of risk.

____7____ sought to reduce concentration by spreading relevant risks. It did not mean that every large collection was automatically safe. The report documented assumptions about relationships, not just the number of contracts.

An amount provided for expected future claims was recorded as a ____8____ in the exercise. This accounting provision was not identical to immediately available cash. ____9____ concerned the ability to meet payments when due, whereas ____10____ concerned the broader ability to meet obligations under the stated financial assessment.

The seminar did not certify a real insurer. It showed why premium totals, modelled losses, dependence and payment resources answered different questions. A convincing large number could not substitute for understanding how the risks and obligations were connected.

questions.prompt: Many Policies, One Storm: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: grouped insurance contracts为pool风险池。transfer转移、underwriting承保过程、reserve准备金不是这些合同汇集体的名称。

questions.prompt: Many Policies, One Storm: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: price paid cover定义premium保费。deductible为自负额非购买保障价格，reserve为未来义务准备、claims为申请赔付，均不等。

questions.prompt: Many Policies, One Storm: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: requests payment under contracts定义claims索赔。premium收价、exposure风险敞口、reserve准备不是申请支付的复数请求。

questions.prompt: Many Policies, One Storm: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: extent risk taken defines exposure风险敞口。volatility波动度不同于所承担范围，premium价格、solvency能力非这一风险总敞口概念。

questions.prompt: Many Policies, One Storm: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: without specified dependence定义independent独立。correlated趋同相反，actuarial精算性质不说明相关结构，other terms不合形容词。

questions.prompt: Many Policies, One Storm: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: same storm tend occur together定义correlated相关。independent相反，actuarial仅领域属性，其他候选不表损失共同变动关系。

questions.prompt: Many Policies, One Storm: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: spread relevant risks reduce concentration定义diversification分散化。underwriting承保范围更广不等于分散，transfer转移一项也非这里明确跨风险分布策略。

questions.prompt: Many Policies, One Storm: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: provision expected future claims定义reserve准备金。liquidity立即支付能力、premium进款、deductible自负额不是这个会计准备；不等现金。

questions.prompt: Many Policies, One Storm: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: meet payments when due定义liquidity流动性。solvency总体偿付条件不同，reserve记账准备不保证能即时付款，其他名词不合。

questions.prompt: Many Policies, One Storm: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: broader ability obligations assessment定义solvency偿付能力。liquidity短期付款可用不等整体义务覆盖，volatility波动、premium价格均不是该能力。

units.title: 六级选词：交叉试验中的顺序与残留效应
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: The Second Period Remembered the First
materials.text:
A fictional methods class examined a ____1____ design in which the same participant experienced two study conditions at different times. Each defined span was a ____2____, with observations linked to the condition used then. The intervention being compared was labelled a ____3____ for the exercise, without implying a real medical recommendation.

The order of conditions formed a ____4____. It could matter if people changed over time or remembered earlier experience. The design used a ____5____ order under its stated assignment procedure, determined by chance rather than each participant choosing the preferred starting condition.

An effect persisting from the first condition into the next was ____6____. A planned ____7____ interval allowed the relevant effects to diminish where the study assumptions made that appropriate. Its existence did not guarantee every possible lasting influence had disappeared.

The ____8____ within a participant could reduce some differences between people. It did not remove every source of ____9____, including changes across periods. The class stated which quantities the design was intended to compare instead of treat one person as an unchanging measuring instrument.

For a selected outcome, an assessor was ____10____ to the condition label, kept unaware of it under the described process. That did not mean the participant was necessarily unaware of what they had experienced.

The account connected repeated participation with order, persistence and assessment. A convenient design label could not establish suitability without those assumptions, and a result obtained under one sequence would not automatically answer every question about another.

questions.prompt: The Second Period Remembered the First: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: same participant both conditions different times定义crossover交叉设计。allocation分配总过程、baseline起点、endpoint结果不指同人轮换结构。

questions.prompt: The Second Period Remembered the First: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: defined time span each condition定义period阶段。sequence为阶段次序、baseline开始值、endpoint终点不是持续时间段本身。

questions.prompt: The Second Period Remembered the First: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: intervention label defined treatment处理。volunteer为参与者、endpoint测量结果、allocation分配不命名被比较条件处理。

questions.prompt: The Second Period Remembered the First: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: order conditions定义sequence顺序。comparison为比较过程、period单阶段、baseline起始状态都不是先后组合。

questions.prompt: The Second Period Remembered the First: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: chance rather chosen order定义randomised随机化。masked为不知标签而非随机选序，withdrawn为退出，其他候选不作该分配性质分词。

questions.prompt: The Second Period Remembered the First: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: effect persists first into next定义carryover残留效应。washout间隔旨在减残留而非残留本身，variability泛变化、baseline基线不直接指前期延续影响。

questions.prompt: The Second Period Remembered the First: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: interval allowing effects diminish定义washout洗脱间隔。baseline起始时点不保证留间隔，endpoint结果、allocation分配不是这里的阶段之间等待。

questions.prompt: The Second Period Remembered the First: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: within participant comparing two conditions定义comparison比较。allocation把人或序分派不同于条件结果对比，variability是差异现象不是比较动作。

questions.prompt: The Second Period Remembered the First: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: differences changes across periods为variability变异。carryover仅一种延续效应不能概括所有差异，baseline起点、endpoint单结果非总变化。

questions.prompt: The Second Period Remembered the First: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: assessor unaware condition defines masked遮盲。randomised指抽分不保证不知道，withdrawn退出不是保评者不知，其他候选不合。

units.title: 六级选词：无损压缩与有损近似
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: The File That Became Smaller
materials.text:
A fictional computing lesson represented a file as a ____1____, a sequence of binary symbols. Repeated or predictable structure could create ____2____ that a coding method might represent more compactly. The method also had to preserve the information needed to interpret its compact representation.

A ____3____ process allowed recovery of the ____4____ original sequence under the stated conditions. It did not merely produce something that looked similar. The class distinguished that requirement from ____5____ compression, which permitted selected information to be discarded or approximated.

One source of approximation was ____6____, mapping values onto a smaller set of available levels. Whether the resulting difference mattered depended on the use. A ____7____ judgement concerned what a listener or viewer could notice, not an assertion that the stored symbols remained identical.

The ____8____ implemented the relevant encoding and decoding procedure. When the representation was ____9____, the appropriate process reconstructed an output. Reconstructing an output was not automatically proof that no information had been lost; the method and its declared guarantees mattered.

The class counted the ____10____ required by the representation, including relevant supporting information rather than only the most flattering part of the file. A smaller number could be useful without settling whether the output met the task. Archival preservation, quick transmission and a human preview might place different demands on the same material, so the report stated which question its compression result answered.

questions.prompt: The File That Became Smaller: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: sequence binary symbols直接定义bitstream位流。codec程序、entropy信息量性质、storage空间不是组成文件的符号序列本身。

questions.prompt: The File That Became Smaller: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: repeated predictable structure compact representation对应redundancy冗余。entropy是不确定性度量不同于可省重复，latency延迟、sampling取样不命名此重复信息。

questions.prompt: The File That Became Smaller: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: recover exact original defines lossless无损。lossy允许丢近似反义，perceptual感知标准不保证逐符号恢复，semantic意义层也不保证。

questions.prompt: The File That Became Smaller: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: original sequence identical requirement需exact完全精确。perceptual是感知、semantic是意义，不保二进制全同，lossy有损与无损定义矛盾。

questions.prompt: The File That Became Smaller: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: permits discard approximate定义lossy有损。lossless反义，perceptual是评判标准但非许丢的编码类别，semantic不定义该保证。

questions.prompt: The File That Became Smaller: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: map smaller available levels定义quantisation量化。sampling从位置时刻取值不同于减少表示层级，latency延迟、entropy不确定度不是映射过程。

questions.prompt: The File That Became Smaller: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: listener viewer can notice定义perceptual感知的。semantic关注意义可保意义也有可察差别，exact符号一致反而本段不保证，其他项不合。

questions.prompt: The File That Became Smaller: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: encoding decoding implementation定义codec编解码器。bitstream被处理数据、storage空间、latency时延非执行编解码方法的组件。

questions.prompt: The File That Became Smaller: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: appropriate procedure reconstruct output定义decoded解码。transmitted传输只是移送不等解释还原，lossless形容性质不能作该动作，其他项不合。

questions.prompt: The File That Became Smaller: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: space representation plus supporting info定义storage存储量。latency是时延、entropy是理论性质不是本次文件所占存储，bitstream数据序列非空间需求本身。

units.title: 六级选词：隐喻中的来源域与推论
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: An Argument Became a Bridge
materials.text:
A fictional literature seminar considered the sentence her argument was a bridge. The teacher called it a ____1____. The claim was not ____2____: no physical construction had appeared where the reasoning was written. Its ____3____ use invited the reader to understand one kind of thing through another.

The bridge supplied a ____4____ domain, the set of ideas from which selected relationships were drawn. The argument was the ____5____ domain to be understood. The mapping did not require every property of a bridge to apply. Weight limits, paint colour or ownership might have no role in the sentence.

A feature made ____6____ by the surrounding discussion could become especially noticeable, such as connecting two positions. The expression’s ____7____ could also include associated values or feelings, not just a dictionary definition. Different readers might not share every association.

Some figurative uses became ____8____ through familiarity. That did not mean they could never be examined, or that every familiar use carried precisely the same effect in a new passage. ____9____ helped establish what the expression was doing here, including who spoke and what preceded it.

The reader’s resulting ____10____ was a conclusion drawn from the wording and situation. It could be supported without being an explicit list of facts the sentence had stated. The seminar therefore distinguished an interpretation from the assumption that any possible association with a bridge must have been intended by the writer.

questions.prompt: An Argument Became a Bridge: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: argument was bridge跨域描写并非实物，called a metaphor隐喻。analogy虽相关但需an且通常显比较形式，此句教师命名隐喻；polysemy多义不是该句映射术语。

questions.prompt: An Argument Became a Bridge: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: no physical construction直接说明not literal非字面。figurative是随后正向描述，transparent透明不表真假实物，pragmatic语用不等字面。

questions.prompt: An Argument Became a Bridge: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: understand one through another定义figurative比喻性的。literal字面相反，conventional惯常不必比喻，register为名词语体不合。

questions.prompt: An Argument Became a Bridge: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: ideas drawn from bridge定义source来源域。target是被解释的argument相反，context场景、register语体不指提供映射的一域。

questions.prompt: An Argument Became a Bridge: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: argument to be understood定义target目标域。source为提供桥梁概念的域，context周边、connotation关联义均不指被阐释的对象域。

questions.prompt: An Argument Became a Bridge: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: especially noticeable定义salient显著。transparent透明可易懂不等突出，conventional熟悉也未必聚焦某特征，literal字面不指注意度。

questions.prompt: An Argument Became a Bridge: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: associated feelings values beyond definition定义connotation内涵联想。polysemy是多个意义结构、analogy比较关系、register语体不等附带情感价值。

questions.prompt: An Argument Became a Bridge: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: through familiarity become conventional惯常的。transparent易明白未必惯常，salient突出、literal字面、pragmatic语用都不说明熟用地位。

questions.prompt: An Argument Became a Bridge: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: who spoke what preceded定义context语境。register只语言风格层次，polysemy词多义、analogy比较均非完整交际环境。

questions.prompt: An Argument Became a Bridge: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: conclusion drawn wording situation定义inference推论。metaphor表达方式本身、connotation关联值、context环境都不是读者据此形成的结论。

units.title: 六级选词：地震事件大小与局部地面运动
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: One Event, Different Ground Records
materials.text:
A fictional earth-science lesson described an earthquake involving ____1____ along a fault, a breaking and slipping process. The event’s size was expressed through a stated ____2____ measure. The class did not confuse that estimate with the ____3____ at a particular location, the experienced or assessed effects there.

The ____4____ was the surface point above the modelled start of the rupture. It was a location, not the name of every place where shaking occurred. Distance and the path through the ground could affect local observations.

A ground-motion trace might describe ____5____, how quickly velocity changed. ____6____ concerned change of position per unit time, while ____7____ referred to the change of position itself. These quantities had different units and could not be substituted merely because their curves looked related.

The ____8____ of shaking was its extent in time. A long record did not by itself establish a larger event-size estimate. Local ____9____ conditions, including the ground at the observing place, could alter the result.

The lesson also described ____10____, a reduction of motion under a specified model of propagation over distance. This did not guarantee that every more distant location would have weaker effects than every nearer one, because local conditions mattered too.

The report named its quantities and assumptions. It offered a way to interpret a described record, not a prediction of an actual earthquake or a judgement that a particular building was suitable.

questions.prompt: One Event, Different Ground Records: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: breaking slipping fault定义rupture破裂。aftershock是后续地震非断裂过程名，displacement位置变是测量量不是此故障过程总称。

questions.prompt: One Event, Different Ground Records: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: event size measure定义magnitude震级。intensity局部效应强度不同，amplitude单波幅不等完整事件大小指标，duration时长不等震级。

questions.prompt: One Event, Different Ground Records: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: effects particular location定义intensity烈度或影响强度。magnitude源事件大小，amplitude运动峰值属性不完整等局地影响评估，其他词不合。

questions.prompt: One Event, Different Ground Records: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: surface above rupture start定义epicentre震中。site泛观测点不特指源点正上，spectrum谱、aftershock后震均非该位置。

questions.prompt: One Event, Different Ground Records: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: rate velocity changes定义acceleration加速度。velocity位移时间率、displacement位置差、amplitude幅值不等速度变化率。

questions.prompt: One Event, Different Ground Records: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: position change per time定义velocity速度。acceleration速度变化率，displacement位移本身，duration时间长不合。

questions.prompt: One Event, Different Ground Records: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: change position itself定义displacement位移。velocity、acceleration都多时间率，amplitude为幅值大小不是这里所定义位置改变量本身。

questions.prompt: One Event, Different Ground Records: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: extent in time直接定义duration持续时长。magnitude事件大小、spectrum频谱、saturation饱和都不表示这段时间长度。

questions.prompt: One Event, Different Ground Records: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: ground at observing place定义site场地。epicentre特定震中不等每个观测处局地，recorded分词、amplitude幅值非地点修饰名词。

questions.prompt: One Event, Different Ground Records: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: reduction motion propagation distance model定义attenuation衰减。saturation饱和、spectrum频谱、aftershock后震都不指传播中振动减弱现象。

units.title: 六级选词：社交网络试验中的分配与间接影响
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: The Benefit Reached the Neighbour
materials.text:
A fictional social-programme study first defined its ____1____ of analysis, the entity counted in the comparison. An account, a household and an individual were not assumed interchangeable. The procedure then recorded ____2____ to conditions, which group each eligible entity had been allocated to.

____3____ used chance in that allocation. The ____4____ condition supplied the stated comparison arrangement, not an assertion that nothing at all happened to those participants. Before the intervention, a ____5____ measure recorded the starting state.

Actual ____6____ concerned what a participant encountered, which could differ from the assigned opportunity. ____7____ described following the allocated arrangement. A person might receive an invitation without attending, so the record kept those events separate.

The programme also affected neighbours who had not directly received it. Such an indirect effect was a ____8____ under the study’s definition. Treating every person’s outcome as isolated from every other assignment would then miss a relevant relationship.

The team considered allocating a ____9____, a group connected for this purpose, rather than assume individual allocation always suited the question. This required a design and analysis matching the grouping, not just a new label on an old spreadsheet.

The report examined whether the relevant conditions were ____10____ across the comparisons, unchanged in the respects its argument required. A familiar programme name did not guarantee this if delivery differed. The exercise made unit, assignment, receipt and network effects inspectable instead of use random allocation as a general promise that every later interpretation would be simple.

questions.prompt: The Benefit Reached the Neighbour: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: entity counted analysis定义unit分析单位。cluster是一种分组单位但此处概念可账户人家庭，assignment为分配、version为版本均非通用分析实体概念。

questions.prompt: The Benefit Reached the Neighbour: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: allocated group记录定义assignment分配。exposure实际遇到、compliance遵从均后续事件，variance变异不指被划到哪条件。

questions.prompt: The Benefit Reached the Neighbour: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: used chance allocation定义randomisation随机化。attrition退出、spillover间接效应、baseline起点、control比较组不指抽签分配。

questions.prompt: The Benefit Reached the Neighbour: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: stated comparison arrangement定义control对照条件。untreated未接受可处理性质但不保证无事，本文强调对照非绝对空白，weighted加权非条件名。

questions.prompt: The Benefit Reached the Neighbour: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: before intervention starting state定义baseline基线。version版本、assignment分配、exposure接触不等前测起点；其他词不合。

questions.prompt: The Benefit Reached the Neighbour: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: what actually encountered定义exposure实际接触。assignment仅机会分配、compliance遵从是接触与分配关系不等本身，其他名词不合。

questions.prompt: The Benefit Reached the Neighbour: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: following allocated arrangement定义compliance遵从。exposure只是遇到可能非分配安排，attrition退出相反事件，variance变异不表遵从。

questions.prompt: The Benefit Reached the Neighbour: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: effect reaches nonrecipients neighbours定义spillover溢出效应。attrition是流失、variance总变异、version版本不是间接受益，其他候选不合。

questions.prompt: The Benefit Reached the Neighbour: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: group connected purpose定义cluster群组。unit泛单位但第1空已锁总定义，这里特指一起分配的组；version版本、control条件不等连接群体。

questions.prompt: The Benefit Reached the Neighbour: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: unchanged relevant respects定义stable稳定。weighted为加权而非条件不变，untreated未处理、randomisation名词均不说明跨比较相关条件一致。
